seeds.scene: A 6-frame time-lapse of a sundial. Frame A: shadow points NW. Frame B: shadow points N. Frame C: shadow points NE. Frame D: shadow points E. Frame E: shadow points SE. Frame F: shadow points S. The sundial is in the Northern Hemisphere.
seeds.question: What is the correct chronological order of the frames from morning to evening?
seeds.answer: A, B, C, D, E, F
seeds.lever: Shadow points opposite of sun. Sun moves E→S→W; shadow moves W→N→E. Morning shadow NW (A) → noon shadow N (B) → afternoon shadow NE/E/SE → late shadow S as sun sets behind. Read shadow rotation as a clock.

seeds.scene: A 4-week Gantt chart with 5 tasks: T1 (week 1, design), T2 (weeks 2-3, code), T3 (week 2, review), T4 (weeks 3-4, test), T5 (week 4, deploy). Dependency arrows: T1→T2, T1→T3, T2→T4, T3→T4, T4→T5.
seeds.question: What is the EARLIEST week T5 can start?
seeds.lever: Critical path: T1(w1)→T2(w2-3)→T4(w3-4)→T5; T5 must wait for T4 completion at end of w4. Actually T5 starts at w4 (after T4 finishes). Earliest start of T5 = beginning of week 4? T4 spans w3-4 finishing end of w4 → T5 starts after — but T5 is in week 4 per chart, so start of week 4 = simultaneous with T4 end? The chart shows T5 in week 4 → answer week 4.

seeds.scene: Two photographs of a stopwatch from a lab experiment. First photo (start): shows 00:42.3. Second photo (end): shows 03:18.7. Both are mm:ss.t format.
seeds.question: How much time elapsed between the photos?

seeds.scene: 5 photos of the same tomato plant taken weekly. Week 1: small green fruit. Week 2: larger green. Week 3: green-yellow stripes. Week 4: orange-red. Week 5: full red, slight wrinkle (overripe).
seeds.question: Which week is the tomato at PEAK eating ripeness (red but firm)?
seeds.lever: Identify between under-ripe and over-ripe; peak = full color but not wrinkled.

seeds.scene: An intersection's traffic light schedule: NS direction is green for 40s, yellow for 5s, red for 35s. EW direction has the complementary schedule (red while NS green, etc.). At t=0 the NS light just turned green.
seeds.question: What color is the EW light at t = 47s?
seeds.lever: EW is red 0-45s (matching NS green 0-40 + NS yellow 40-45), then green 45-80s, then yellow 80-85, then red 85+. At t=47s → EW green.

seeds.scene: Six construction site photos of the same building project: P1 = empty lot. P2 = excavated foundation hole. P3 = poured concrete foundation. P4 = steel frame skeleton up. P5 = exterior walls and windows installed. P6 = interior finishings + landscaping done.
seeds.question: Which phase shows the structure 'enclosed' (weatherproof) for the first time?
seeds.lever: Identify the threshold transition: walls + windows = first 'enclosed' phase.

seeds.scene: A photo-finish strip from a 100m race showing 5 runners crossing the line at slightly different times. Strip indicates: lane 3 broke the tape first; lane 1 came second by 0.05s; lane 5 third; lane 2 fourth; lane 4 fifth.
seeds.question: Who came in 4th place?

seeds.scene: A candle 20 cm tall when new burns at a constant rate of 1.5 cm/hour. A photo shows the candle currently 12.5 cm tall.
seeds.question: How many hours has the candle been burning?

seeds.scene: A cooling curve graph: coffee starts at 90°C and cools toward room temp 20°C. The graph shows temperature at times: t=0:90°C, t=10min:60°C, t=20min:42°C, t=30min:31°C, t=40min:25°C, t=50min:22°C.
seeds.question: After what time is the coffee 'drinkable' (≤55°C)?
seeds.lever: Read curve interpolation; between t=10 (60°C) and t=20 (42°C), 55°C falls early in interval.

seeds.scene: A weekly calendar showing appointments. Monday: 9-11 (Meeting A), 10:30-12 (Meeting B), 14-15 (Workshop). Tuesday: 9-10, 11-12, 14-16 (no overlaps). Wednesday: 8-12 (Conference), 11-13 (Lunch with client). Thursday and Friday: no conflicts.
seeds.question: How many days have at least one scheduling conflict?
seeds.lever: Detect overlapping intervals: Mon 10:30-11 overlap (A∩B), Wed 11-12 overlap (Conf∩Lunch). Two days.

seeds.scene: 5 stop-motion frames of a bouncing ball: F1 ball at top of arc on left, F2 ball mid-air right of F1, F3 ball touching ground, F4 ball mid-air right of F3, F5 ball at top of arc on right.
seeds.question: If played in chronological order, in which direction does the ball move (overall)?
seeds.lever: Trace ball horizontal positions across frames.

seeds.scene: A tide chart for one day with high tides at 4:30 (1.8m) and 16:50 (1.6m), low tides at 10:45 (0.4m) and 23:10 (0.5m). A surfer wants to surf at the SECOND high tide.
seeds.question: What time should they arrive?
seeds.lever: Identify the second of two high tides.

seeds.scene: Three street photos: Panel 1 dry pavement, sunny shadows, people in t-shirts. Panel 2 wet pavement, raindrops in air, people running with newspapers over heads. Panel 3 wet pavement with puddles, sunny again, people walking calmly.
seeds.question: What is the chronological order?

seeds.scene: A digital exam timer showing '00:23:47' counting down. A student took 12 minutes 30 seconds for question 1, and there are 4 questions remaining.
seeds.question: On average, how much time is left per remaining question?

seeds.scene: Field photo: deciduous trees in full green leaves, a bear with two cubs foraging berries, butterflies visible, no flowers but green grass tall, bees active, river running fast with snowmelt fully gone.
seeds.question: Which season is this most likely?
seeds.answer: Mid-summer (or late spring transitioning to summer)
seeds.lever: Combine cues: full green leaves (not spring-fresh), berries ripening, butterflies + bees active, snowmelt past.

seeds.scene: Two analog clocks side by side. Clock A reads 9:35. Clock B reads 12:10 (PM). Both are on the same day.
seeds.question: How much time elapsed from clock A to clock B?
seeds.lever: Read both analog clocks; subtract times.

seeds.scene: A tank with capacity 1000 L being filled. Inflow rate 25 L/min from one pipe and 15 L/min from another (both pipes open). Tank has a leak draining 5 L/min. Currently the tank shows 200 L filled.
seeds.question: How long until the tank is completely full?
seeds.lever: Net fill rate = 25+15-5 = 35 L/min. Remaining = 800 L. Time = 800/35 ≈ 22.857 min = 22 min 51 sec.

seeds.scene: A graph of radioactive decay: starting amount 1000 mg at t=0, half-life 8 days. The graph shows decay at days 0, 4, 8, 16, 24.
seeds.question: What is the remaining amount at day 24?

seeds.scene: Four photos of a butterfly lifecycle in order: egg cluster on a leaf; caterpillar feeding; chrysalis hanging; emerged butterfly wings drying.
seeds.question: Which stage shows METAMORPHOSIS occurring INTERNALLY?
seeds.lever: Identify pupa stage (chrysalis) where the body is internally restructured.

seeds.scene: Flight ticket: departs Tokyo (UTC+9) at 14:30 local time on Monday. Flight duration 11 hours. Destination: New York (UTC-5).
seeds.question: What is the local arrival time in New York?
seeds.lever: Tokyo 14:30 = UTC 05:30 + 11h flight = UTC 16:30 = NY 11:30. Same calendar day.
